evidence_quote: First, we curate a large-scale dataset of 300K real residential floorplans to train a large language model for whole-home floorplan generation.
statement: The authors curated a large-scale dataset of 300,000 real residential floorplans to train a large language model for whole-home floorplan generation.

evidence_quote: With detailed descriptions and a K-D tree-based representation, our method enables fine-grained, controllable whole-home floorplan generation.
statement: The proposed method uses a K-D tree-based representation and detailed descriptions to enable fine-grained, controllable whole-home floorplan generation.

evidence_quote: Building upon the generated whole-home floorplan, we leverage image generation models to draft furniture layouts from multi-level roaming viewpoints, and then generate the layouts of small manipulable objects on different supporting surfaces (e.g., cabinets, desks, and dining tables) for embodied AI simulation.
statement: The framework leverages image generation models to draft furniture layouts from multi-level roaming viewpoints and generates layouts of small manipulable objects on supporting surfaces.

evidence_quote: During furniture and object layout generation, a VLM-based refiner iteratively corrects furniture and object placement, and a 3D generative model enables flexible replacement of individual assets.
statement: A VLM-based refiner is used to iteratively correct furniture and object placement, while a 3D generative model allows for the flexible replacement of individual assets.

evidence_quote: We further attach basic physical attributes and simple surface texture and lighting setups to complete the pipeline for embodied AI use.
statement: The pipeline attaches basic physical attributes, simple surface textures, and lighting setups to complete the scene for embodied AI use.

evidence_quote: Experiments and user studies demonstrate that our pipeline produces indoor spaces with greater layout diversity and stronger 3D design appeal, outperforming prior methods on both quantitative and qualitative metrics.
statement: Experiments and user studies show that the proposed pipeline produces indoor spaces with greater layout diversity and stronger 3D design appeal, outperforming prior methods on quantitative and qualitative metrics.

evidence_quote: Finally, alongside our generation pipeline, we will release the floorplan dataset and 5K fully furnished scenes to the community.
statement: The authors plan to release the 300K floorplan dataset and 5,000 fully furnished scenes to the community alongside their generation pipeline.

evidence_quote: we introduce OmniDreams, a foundation generative world model mid- and post-trained from the Cosmos diffusion model to autoregressively generate action-conditioned videos in real time.
statement: OmniDreams is a foundation generative world model that is mid- and post-trained from the Cosmos diffusion model to autoregressively generate action-conditioned videos in real time.

evidence_quote: mid- and post-training on 21k hours of driving scenarios
statement: The OmniDreams model is mid- and post-trained on a dataset comprising 21,000 hours of driving scenarios.

evidence_quote: OmniDreams synthesizes complex, unobserved phenomena that are hard for traditional simulators to capture, such as extreme weather and unpredictable dynamic agent behaviors.
statement: OmniDreams is capable of synthesizing complex, unobserved phenomena that are difficult for traditional simulators to capture, such as extreme weather and unpredictable dynamic agent behaviors.

evidence_quote: it autoregressively conditions its photorealistic sensor generation on past frames, the current simulator state, and immediate driving actions.
statement: The model autoregressively conditions its photorealistic sensor generation on past frames, the current simulator state, and immediate driving actions.

evidence_quote: Deployed in a closed-loop system with the Alpamayo 1 policy model and AlpaSim orchestrator, OmniDreams acts as a highly responsive, reactive environment
statement: OmniDreams is deployed in a closed-loop system alongside the Alpamayo 1 policy model and the AlpaSim orchestrator to act as a responsive and reactive environment.

evidence_quote: a world-action model (WAM) post-trained from OmniDreams achieves strong performance on the Physical AI Autonomous Vehicles NuRec dataset
statement: A world-action model (WAM) post-trained from OmniDreams was evaluated on the Physical AI Autonomous Vehicles NuRec dataset.

evidence_quote: surpassing the VLA-based Alpamayo 1.5 research policy model while using only 1/5 the total parameters.
statement: The WAM post-trained from OmniDreams surpasses the VLA-based Alpamayo 1.5 research policy model on the NuRec dataset while using only one-fifth of the total parameters.

evidence_quote: While recent reconstruction-based neural simulators offer photorealism, they are fundamentally constrained by their initial captured data and struggle to generalize to highly dynamic or novel scenes.
statement: Reconstruction-based neural simulators are fundamentally constrained by their initial captured data and struggle to generalize to highly dynamic or novel scenes.

evidence_quote: To address this limitation, we propose SeeTraceAct, a demo-conditioned VLA framework that encourages precise spatial grounding through visibility-aware prediction of future end-effector traces.
statement: SeeTraceAct is a demo-conditioned Vision-Language-Action (VLA) framework that uses visibility-aware prediction of future end-effector traces to encourage precise spatial grounding.

evidence_quote: To enable reproducible evaluation with cross-embodiment demonstrations, we introduce and release RoboCasa-DC, a demo-conditioned extension of RoboCasa with episode-paired humanoid videos.
statement: RoboCasa-DC is a demo-conditioned extension of the RoboCasa dataset that includes episode-paired humanoid videos for cross-embodiment demonstrations.

evidence_quote: Experiments on RoboCasa-DC and a real-world benchmark, where a Franka Panda arm is conditioned on human demonstrations, show that SeeTraceAct outperforms baselines, achieving the best success rate across all four RoboCasa-DC settings and improving real-world average success by 12.5 percentage points.
statement: SeeTraceAct achieves the highest success rate across all four RoboCasa-DC settings and improves real-world average success by 12.5 percentage points compared to baselines.

evidence_quote: We find that existing end-to-end approaches often struggle when successful execution requires precisely localizing small target regions.
statement: Existing end-to-end approaches for one-shot demo-conditioned VLAs frequently fail at tasks that require precisely localizing small target regions.

evidence_quote: Experiments on RoboCasa-DC and a real-world benchmark, where a Franka Panda arm is conditioned on human demonstrations, show that SeeTraceAct outperforms baselines
statement: The real-world benchmark used to evaluate SeeTraceAct involves conditioning a Franka Panda arm on human demonstrations.
